label: Bundled demo for `nougen-verse demo`: a synthetic request and a synthetic draft

request.topic: paying rent after the building is sold
request.central_claim: doing everything right does not guarantee a place to stay

draft_lines: Route twelve bus with the heater only hitting my left side
Grandpa's watch in my pocket, still an hour behind
Forty dollars in a sock and a folder of receipts
Seven money order stubs, all stapled, dated, neat
I rehearsed the landlord speech at every yellow light
Told the mirror in my head to keep my shoulders tight
He opened with the building sold on Friday afternoon
I really gotta stay on the grind, you know
